paite: Paul, Pathian sikha leh Jesu Khrist sawitak, Pathian mitelte, aginna uh lamtou ding leh Pathian limsakna toh kithuah thutak theisak ding a sem in;
heading: Chibai Bukna

paite: huai tangtawn hinna lametna a kinga, Pathian zuaugen thei lou in khovel om ma a achiam,
himahleh amah huntak ah thugenna zang in athu ahihlangta, huai thugenna Pathian i Hondampa thupiak bang zel a kepsak ka hi.
Ginna kibang a ka tapa diktak Titas kiang ah, Pathian leh Khrist Jesu i Hondampa kiang a kipan hehpihna, zahngaihna leh khamuanna om hen.
Hiai ziak in ahi huai Kret tuikulh a nang ka hon nutsiat, thilhih zoh nailouhte na hihzoh theihna ding leh thu ka hon piak bang a, khua teng a upate na sehtheihna ding in.
heading: Upate Sehna

paite: Upa ding zaw gensiatbei, zi khat nei, tate Pathian gingta, nopsak bawl luatna lamsang a gensiat loh lou, dan bang lou a om lou, nei ahih peuhmah uleh,
saptuam heutu Pathian nasep enkaimi ahih ziak in gensiatbei ahih ding ahi; migenhak, lunggam, uain khamhat, mivuak hat, punna nin a huaihammi hi ding hilou ahi.
Mi kipahpihdan siam, hoih lam deih, lungsim diktak, midiktat, misiangthou, kidektheimi ahih ding ahi.
Asinsa thuhilhna dik midang sinsak thei leh selhat mite siam louh tangsak thei ding a sinsak a om thugin muanhuai lenkip mi ahi ding hi.
Dan bang lou a om, thu mawk gengen leh mikhem chingmi tampi, abik in zeksumte lak a mi a-om uhi.
heading: Sinsakmi Takloute

paite: Huai mite kam humsak ding ahi, punna nin deih ziak a thuhilh louh ding hilh in, mite a-inkuankuan un apisia uhi.
Amaute lak a mi azawlnei khat un houh: "Kret tuikulh a mite zaw zuautheite, gamsa giloute, thadah anhaite ahi uh," achi hi.
Hiai theihpihna adik ahi. Huaiziak in ginna a adiktheihna ding un leh,
Judate tangthu phuahtawmte a kisubuai lou ding leh thutak nungngatsan nakte thupiak alimsaklouhna ding un naktak in taihilh in.
Siangthoute a ding in bangkim asiangthou hi; himahleh minin leh gingloute a ding in bangmah siangthou a-om kei, alungsim uh asia-le-pha theihna uh leng anin hi.
Pathian thei akichi ua, himahleh athilhih un anawlkhin nak uhi. Kihhuaite, thumangloute, thil hoih sep ding peuhmah a deihlouhte ahi uhi.
